dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, can you write a short report about our new tours?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈraɪt ə ˈʃɔːrt rɪˈpɔːrt əˈbaʊt aʊr ˈnuː ˈtʊrz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Please hand it in by Friday.
dialogue.reading: ˈpliːz ˈhænd ɪt ˈɪn baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By Friday? OK. Will you be in the office on Friday?
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ? oʊˈkeɪ. wɪl juː bi ɪn ði ˈɔːfɪs ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good. I need some photos from Kate, but she's on vacation until Wednesday.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. aɪ ˈniːd sʌm ˈfoʊtoʊz frəm ˈkeɪt, bʌt ʃiːz ɑːn veɪˈkeɪʃən ənˈtɪl ˈwɛnzdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Don't worry. She can send them to you on Thursday. You'll get them in time.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ʃiː kən ˈsɛnd ðɛm tə juː ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ. juːl ˈɡɛt ðɛm ɪn ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll work late on Thursday.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈwɜːrk ˈleɪt ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Don't rush. It doesn't have to be perfect.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈrʌʃ. ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈhæf tə bi ˈpɜːrfɪkt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll hand it in by Friday afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. aɪl ˈhænd ɪt ˈɪn baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn.
